af3_excluded_ligands.role: crystallisation aids and buffers excluded from ligand conditioning; keeps real cofactors such as ZN, MG, FE
af3_excluded_ligands.source: AlphaFold3 Supp. Table 10, via RosettaCommons/atomworks constants.AF3_EXCLUDED_LIGANDS

rcsb_assemblies.role: coordinates from which all conditioning is derived
rcsb_assemblies.stability: immutable per accession; each downloaded file is hashed into provenance.json

rcsb_clusters_30.role: 30% sequence-identity clusters, keyed by ENTITY id; the unit of homology exclusion
rcsb_clusters_30.stability: regenerated weekly; pinned by recorded digest

rcsb_entry_index.role: bulk entry metadata: id, deposition date, resolution, method, HEADER classification
rcsb_entry_index.stability: regenerated as the PDB grows; pinned by the digest recorded into provenance.json

rfdiffusion3_benchmark.contamination: targets are pre-2010 PDB entries and are in the training set of every current design model; inherent to the benchmark and documented, not solved
rfdiffusion3_benchmark.provenance: RFdiffusion3 benchmark targets; success criteria in each track's success.txt
rfdiffusion3_benchmark.role: the 50 evaluation targets: 41 M-CSA enzyme active sites, 4 small-molecule sites, 5 binder targets
rfdiffusion3_benchmark.supplied_by: operator, as a directory of input.yaml + motif/ligand .cif files

note: Pinned upstream sources. Digests marked verified were checked by download on the stated date; entries marked unverified are recorded honestly and re-checked at run time, since these URLs are mutable.

boltzdesign1.role: architecture reference; trains nothing, inverts a pretrained predictor at inference

boltzgen.role: architecture reference; all-atom generative binder design

framediff.note: Literature reference only. Nothing from FrameDiff is shipped or used: an earlier hand-written starter reimplemented its frame representation and ideal-atom placement as an output head, and that starter has been removed in favour of vendoring upstream RFdiffusion3, which diffuses Cartesian all-atom coordinates and has no frame or rotation channel.
framediff.role: background reference for frame-based backbone diffusion; not used by this task

proteina_complexa.license: Apache-2.0 (code); CC BY 4.0 (datasets); NVIDIA Open Model License (weights, commercially usable)
proteina_complexa.note: The original Proteina repository is research/non-commercial only; Proteina-Complexa is not. See its licenses/ directory for full terms and third-party notices.
proteina_complexa.role: architecture reference; partially-latent flow matching with inference-time search

rfdiffusion3.used_by_starter: environment/baseline/rfd3-small/rfd3 vendors this source at the pinned revision and the starter trains it directly. The only change is layer widths, via configs/experiment/pretrain_small.yaml (12,445,554 parameters against upstream's 168,038,994); block counts, condition mix, transforms, losses, optimizer, schedule and EMA are upstream's. Architecture and recipe only; no RFD3 weights are used, and every parameter is randomly initialised and trained in-session.
rfdiffusion3.role: the dataset construction and success criteria this task follows

ligandmpnn.placement: source VENDORED at environment/evaluation/ligandmpnn (MIT, license retained; run.py's import closure only - see its VENDORED.md) and COPYed to /opt/ligandmpnn in both images, so neither build clones it; parameters PUBLIC and baked into both images at /assets/ligandmpnn_params by environment/fetch_designability_weights.sh
ligandmpnn.role: ligand-aware inverse folding; supplies the sequences each criterion scores
ligandmpnn.substitution_note: The original repository deliberately, NOT foundry's models/mpnn re-implementation: upstream advises against the latter for benchmarking, and its ligand_mpnn was measured returning byte-identical sequences with and without a bound ligand.

rf3.citation: Accelerating Biomolecular Modeling with AtomWorks and RF3, Institute for Protein Design (2025), doi:10.1101/2025.08.14.670328
rf3.license: BSD-3-Clause (code and model parameters), Institute for Protein Design, University of Washington
rf3.placement: source vendored at environment/evaluation/rf3; parameters PUBLIC and baked into both images at /assets/rf3 by environment/fetch_designability_weights.sh
rf3.role: complex prediction; the only source of ipTM and interface PAE, and the only way to refold a protein-ligand complex
rf3.substitution_note: Replaces AlphaFold 3, whose parameters are not redistributable and therefore could not run in the agent image. RFdiffusion3's published thresholds were calibrated with AlphaFold, so scores are internally comparable but NOT directly comparable with the RFdiffusion3 paper. Its enzyme criterion uses Chai-1, which is a further substitution.
